scientific_scope: Prescribed membership from recovered filename inventory, recorded configuration, and frozen commit plus patch. This is not a historical consumed-sample log or proof that a specific training run used every prescribed member.

recipe.ordering: sorted matching .dcm paths, then sorted matching .dicom paths; retain filename prefixes vindr_ and buu_
recipe.rounding: n_train=int(N*train_ratio); n_val=int(N*val_ratio); test is the remainder

limitations: No original 9024-image byte manifest or recovered annotations.csv bytes.
A March20 filesystem snapshot is used to reconstruct the documented configuration; actual runtime overrides or earlier filesystem differences are not authenticated.
drop_last and corrupt-image fallback can make consumed samples differ from prescribed membership.
Source-image membership does not establish patient-level independence.
